name: korzy-research
description: Find US land parcels by address or coordinates, read their records and owners, and check nearby utilities, environmental layers, logistics and data center projects.

interface.longDescription:
Korzy is parcel research for analysts and teams evaluating land in the United States. Look up a parcel by street address or coordinates and read its published record: parcel ID, land use, reported acreage, building size, assessed value and last sale. Owner names and mailing addresses are added only when you ask, at double the credit cost.

Then check what is around the site: water and sewer service areas and treatment plants, flood zones, wetlands and other environmental layers, nearby roads, rail, ports and airports, data center projects, and the parcel's terrain. Answers cite parcel IDs, record dates and units, and say when a record is missing.

The plugin connects to Korzy's MCP server and includes a parcel research skill, a getting-started skill and REST API instructions. It requires a Korzy Professional or Business plan; you sign in with your Korzy account the first time it connects.
defaultPrompt: Look up the parcel at an address I provide and summarize its record.
What parcel is at these coordinates, and what utilities and data centers are nearby?
Check a parcel for flood zones, wetlands and nearby transport.

positive.description: Address lookup: the user wants the record for one street address.
positive.prompt: Look up the parcel at 714 Mordecai Towne Pl, Raleigh, NC and summarize its record.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_parcels with the address, finds the exact match and summarizes its korzy_id, land use, reported acreage, building size, assessed value and last sale with the record date. Does not request owner fields.

positive.description: Coordinate lookup: the user gives a point instead of an address.
positive.prompt: What parcel is at latitude 35.7999, longitude -78.6270? Give me its full record.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_site_context at the point to find the covering parcel, then get_parcel with its korzy_id and the point, and summarizes the record with its map link.

positive.description: Ownership requested explicitly, which costs double.
positive.prompt: Who owns the parcel at 714 Mordecai Towne Pl, Raleigh, NC?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_parcels with include_owner=true and reports the published owner name and mailing address, noting that this is the published record rather than proof of title. Provides no phone numbers or emails.

positive.description: Environmental and utility screening for an address.
positive.prompt: Is the parcel at 714 Mordecai Towne Pl, Raleigh, NC in a flood zone, and what water and sewer service covers it?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the parcel, then reports the water and sewer service areas from get_site_context and the flood zone and other mapped layers from get_environment_context, saying that mapped service areas do not confirm service.

positive.description: Data center projects near a point.
positive.prompt: Which data center projects are near latitude 39.0438, longitude -77.4874, and what is the status of the closest one?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists nearby data center projects with distances from get_site_context, then opens the closest with get_data_center and reports its status, operator and reported capacity with dates.

negative.description: Unrelated request: Korzy tools should not be used.
negative.prompt: What is the weather forecast for Chicago this weekend?

negative.description: Request for a property owner's personal contact details, which Korzy does not provide.
negative.prompt: Find the phone number and email of the owner of 338 5th Avenue in New York.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not provide or invent personal contact information; may offer the parcel record and published owner name instead.

negative.description: Bulk listing across an area, which Korzy does not offer.
negative.prompt: List every 100-acre or larger parcel in Loudoun County, Virginia.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that searching a whole area or listing many parcels isn't available, offers to look up specific addresses or points, and does not invent a list.

publication.release_notes: Parcel search: find a parcel by address or coordinates, read its record by korzy_id, add owners only on request, and check nearby utilities, environmental layers, logistics and data center projects. Updated for current Korzy plans and API.
